not_primary_business: token issuance or guaranteed trading returns

market_ui_rules: Above the fold lead with market candles and research signals, not internal operations headcount.
Public CTAs must lead to the working product: /app, /radar, allowlisted /app?view= pages.
Do not show fictitious price, performance, volume, user counts, AI workers, profitability or fake live indicators.
Market data fallback, incomplete coverage, strategy scores and historical simulation are visibly distinguished.
Company OS, workforce contracts and proof endpoints remain internal operational surfaces, not headline acquisition claims.
Mobile-first responsive chart controls, visible focus, semantic landmarks, keyboard operability and reduced-motion mode.
No clone of competitor trade dress; benchmark capabilities and interaction patterns, not brand or proprietary code.

company_os.role: Internal executive and workforce operating layer to build, test, monitor, grow and maintain SignalForge.
company_os.reality: 100 role specifications are NOT 100 live model workers, 100 paid employees, or verified execution.

departments.executive: Own single product goal, prioritized backlog, dependency and outcome arbitration.
departments.research: Validate candles, onchain intelligence claims, tokenomics and explainable signal methodology.
departments.product: Own customer-first workflow, discovery, market terminal and premium UX quality.
departments.engineering: Implement and maintain actual chart/API/strategy/backtest/research functionality; review code and tests.
departments.data: Ensure source contracts, ingestion integrity, refresh, candle freshness, historical provenance and metrics.
departments.growth: Acquire authentic crypto researchers; optimize SEO, referral quality, activation and retention.
departments.commercial: Operate honest pricing, checkout, signed Stripe lifecycle and collected revenue conversion.
departments.customer: Resolve member support, onboarding, actionable feedback and member education.
departments.trust: Safeguard customer accounts, moderation, anti-manipulation, privacy and research claims.
departments.operations: Own SRE, provider availability, reliability, cost and incident recovery.
departments.verification: Independently read source SHA, CI, deployment, user outcomes and revenue evidence.

decision_priority: customer-critical failures and market data integrity

proof_definition: A deployed code change is verified only by matching GitHub SHA, green CI, active Railway revision, relevant HTTP/user acceptance evidence and independently sourced proof where applicable.
